patch_description:
Crossover combining the best elements:
1. Perfect matching CZ arrangement from the crossover inspiration (optimal parallelism)
2. Mid-circuit mixer splitting CZ into 4+3 matchings (from best prior, score 1.07)
3. Enhancement: full 3-axis (RY→RZ→RX) mid-circuit mixer for maximum SU(2) rotation at the non-commuting barrier, converting the 2-axis mid-mixer into a full Euler decomposition. This should better transform accumulated conditional phases between the two entangling stages.
4. Standard RY+RX input mixer and RZ+RX output mixer from all programs.

Total: 7 shared params × 6 blocks = 42 circuit + 2 readout = 44 params.
The single extra parameter per block (RZ_mid) provides full single-qubit rotation capability at the critical mid-circuit point where non-commutativity creates expressibility.
